description: `create((set, get) => initialState)` returns a hook that is also the store API (`getState`, `setState`, `subscribe`, `getInitialState`).
A selector that returns one primitive or existing reference, such as `(s) => s.isPlaying`. Cheap and stable.
Wraps a selector that builds a new array or object, keeping the previous result while it is shallowly equal. From `zustand/react/shallow`.
Grouping actions under one stable key so components can select all of them without re-rendering.
Exporting `useIsPlaying()`-style hooks instead of the raw store keeps selectors precise and the state shape private.
